t: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
And that within the breasts is obtained,
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.

f.1967: i.e., the horses bearing riders as they race to attack the enemy.
f.1968: Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.
f.1970: i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.
f.1971: Through his speech and his actions.
f.1972: i.e., when all secrets are made known.
f.1973: Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.
